# Quick Plan Mode

Switch to **quick plan mode** for this planning session.

## Behavior Changes

- **Skip all clarifying questions** — Make best-judgment defaults based on codebase analysis
- **No option presentations** — Proceed directly with the strongest approach
- **One-pass artifact creation** — Create master plan, phase docs, and Phase 1 task handoffs without pausing for feedback
- **Present completed plan** — Show the execution summary at the end for review and adjustment

## When to Use

- Well-defined features with clear requirements
- Follow-up projects where patterns are already established
- When the user has already described the feature in detail
- Time-sensitive planning where speed matters more than deliberation
